title: anthemis anthemiformis
intro: Anthemis anthemiformis, commonly known as Chamois or False Chamomile, is a flowering plant in the daisy family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and promoting relaxation. The health benefits of Anthemis anthemiformis are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and calming effects. The bioactive constituents of the plant, such as terpenoids, flavonoids, and essential oils, contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
